title: Security of Iterated Even-Mansour with Identical Keys
summary: The all-identical-key iterated Even-Mansour variant is practically appealing, but its security remains to be determined.

formal_statement.body: Determine the security of the iterated Even-Mansour cipher in the practically appealing variant where all whitening and round keys are identical, $k_0=\cdots=k_t$. The supplied evidence identifies this all-identical-key variant as an unresolved direction of research.

scope.domain: Security analysis of the all-identical-key iterated Even-Mansour block-cipher variant.
parameters: k_0 through k_t: the whitening and round keys, all required to be identical
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the security of the all-identical-key iterated Even-Mansour variant.

citations.label: An Asymptotically Tight Security Analysis of the Iterated Even-Mansour Cipher

progress.summary: The paper singles out the all-identical-key variant as practically appealing and says that it remains an interesting direction of research.
citation_labels: Rodolphe Lampe et al., An Asymptotically Tight Security Analysis of the Iterated Even-Mansour Cipher
